overviewParagraphs: Tan Son Nhat Golf Course holds a unique position in global golf — it is a massive 36-hole complex located in a densely populated urban setting, just five minutes from the centre of Ho Chi Minh City. Adjacent to the international airport, it is frequently the first or last round of the trip for discerning golfers transiting through Saigon.

Designed by Nelson & Haworth, the two layouts offer different character and challenges, both making inventive use of their constrained urban setting. Water features, strategic bunkering, and mature tree lines create a surprisingly authentic golf experience despite the city skyline visible in all directions.

Tan Son Nhat is the most accessible course in southern Vietnam for the convenience-focused golfer. A round here before catching an evening connection flight makes for one of the most memorable pre-departure experiences in Asian golf.

curatorBriefHtml: Tan Son Nhat Golf Course is Ho Chi Minh City’s ultimate convenience play — a sprawling 36-hole Nelson & Haworth championship complex situated directly beside Tan Son Nhat International Airport, just 15–20 minutes from District 1. Across four distinct 9-hole loops (A, B, C, and D; 7,081 yards Blue Tees), the course features bold mounding, large undulating greens, massive sand-flashed bunkers, and full floodlit night golf.

Having played Tan Son Nhat personally, its superpower for touring groups is schedule flexibility. You can land in Ho Chi Minh City mid-morning, play 18 holes before hotel check-in, or squeeze in a final twilight/night round under lights right before an evening flight home — all backed by one of Vietnam’s largest and best-equipped clubhouses with full shower and locker facilities.

Because Tan Son Nhat is hugely popular with local Saigon golfers and Korean business groups, tee times fill quickly on weekends and evenings. AGS locks in confirmed weekday/twilight blocks and pairs Tan Son Nhat seamlessly with VGCC, Long Thanh, or The Bluffs Ho Tram.

scorecard.verdict: Located right next to Tan Son Nhat airport in Ho Chi Minh City, this 36-hole facility is ideal for arrival day or departure rounds. Exceptional floodlit night golf and comprehensive amenities.

faqs.q: How close is Tan Son Nhat Golf Course to Ho Chi Minh City Airport?
faqs.a: Tan Son Nhat sits immediately adjacent to Tan Son Nhat International Airport (SGN) — roughly 5 to 10 minutes from the terminal and 15 to 25 minutes from District 1 hotels, making it the #1 arrival-day or departure-day round in Saigon.

faqs.q: Does Tan Son Nhat Golf Course offer night golf?
faqs.a: Yes. Tan Son Nhat features comprehensive floodlighting for twilight and night golf, allowing groups to tee off in the cool late afternoon and finish under lights without fighting midday tropical heat.

faqs.q: Which 9-hole loops are best among Tan Son Nhat's 36 holes?
faqs.a: Loops A and B offer classic Nelson & Haworth bunkering and rolling contours, while C and D bring tighter water hazards and dramatic risk-reward approaches. All four nines share high-standard Paspalum turf and quick greens.

faqs.q: Can we store luggage and shower at the clubhouse before an evening flight?
faqs.a: Yes. Tan Son Nhat’s massive clubhouse has spacious locker rooms, showers, and restaurants, and your AGS private touring vehicle safely holds your luggage until airport drop-off.
